hypothesis: P1: relative displacement of magnetic and gravity edge ridges, assessed against detrended-elevation structure, may identify buried structural discontinuities not represented in the public fault catalogue.
mechanism: At fixed physical scales, compute gradient-ridge locations for TMI and isostatic gravity, estimate signed cross-normal displacement between the ridges, and test coherent displacement relative to detrended elevation. This is a proposed operator only; no feature was computed in this review.
named_non_fault_mimic: Intrusive or dike contacts, lithologic boundaries, magnetic remanence changes, and survey-line leveling seams.
